name: Oracle Autonomous AI Database
sku: Autonomous AI Database Serverless, covering its lakehouse and data warehouse, transaction processing, JSON and APEX workload types.

store.warehouse.note: The lakehouse and data warehouse workload uses Hybrid Columnar Compression on all tables by default, caches results for every SQL statement, chooses parallelism itself and is tuned for direct-path bulk loads.

serve.query-engine.note: A fully autonomous database that scales elastically and delivers fast query performance with no database administration.

source.oltp.note: A transaction processing workload type for OLTP, alongside the analytics and JSON workloads.

serve.data-apps.note: APEX is offered as a workload type for application development. This score rests on that mention alone; a page describing APEX itself could not be fetched.

bands.note: You do not configure hardware or install software: the service provisions, backs up, patches, upgrades and grows or shrinks the database itself. It manages the database's infrastructure, not yours.

presentation.tagline: Self-managing Oracle database with warehouse, transaction and APEX workloads.
